text:
ana (product): quick thread to lock down the Optimize Toolkit MVP scope. customer asks: per-route batching guidance, prefix/KV cache suggestions, model family quant profiles, and alerting when evals show regressions. want to keep timeline tight. thoughts?

tok (eng): split it: runtime plumbing + recommendation surface. runtime must expose endpoint metadata (applied profile, origin, timestamp). recommendations can be just read-only initially.

neel (ml): quant profiles: start with a very conservative set: fp16 and int8-qlk for the 3 most-used families. include a compatibility map. we should ship a nightly regression that compares anchor prompts using perplexity shift + top-1 accuracy.

maya (design): recommendation card: header (what, why), three bullets (cost delta, expected p50 change, quality risk), and primary CTA Preview (not Apply). small mock coming.

carlos (cs): customers prefer: 1) ability to pin a tenant default, 2) per-route override by engineers, and 3) an audit trail for changes. also one large customer asks for an "opt me in" managed rollout.

tok (eng): constraints: Dedicated cannot switch quant format under the hood without customer opt-in. so auto-apply is blocked for Dedicated. Also batching heuristics must include a max_wait cap to protect latency SLOs.

ana (product): proposed MVP (4-week window):
- runtime: endpoint metadata, KV prefix cache flag, static batching heuristic (no autoscaling logic)
- ml: conservative quant profiles + nightly anchor eval (200 prompts) + regression alerting to email
- ux: read-only recommendations panel with Preview and explainers
- ops: pilot canary tooling (5% traffic, 1h observe) and manual apply only
Ship pilot after pilot customers validate.

neel (ml): clarify alerts: for MVP, send email to CS and product when quality delta >3% by our metric. no pager. human review required before rollback.

tok (eng): infra asks up-front: (1) metadata model and APIs, (2) sim runner to estimate latency/cost for a given profile, (3) telemetry hooks for per-route token counts. small but must be done first two sprints.

maya (design): UX add: confidence indicator (low/med/high) and a short rationale link. keep copy tight for legal.

carlos (cs): pilot plan: i'll recruit two customers: one enterprise (wants tenant default) + one startup (wants per-route control). i'll draft runbook and customer-facing tradeoff doc.

ana (product): launch criteria draft:
- recommendations panel visible in console
- nightly anchor run completes with automated report
- >=1 quant profile applied to pilot customers with no automated rollback triggers in 24h
- telemetry surfaces cost/latency deltas per-route
If satisfied -> expand pilot.

tok (eng): add canary rules: apply to 5% traffic, monitor p50 and error-rate for 60m, rollback if p50 increases >30% or error-rate >0.5%.

neel (ml): measurement plan: perplexity shift, top-k match on anchors, and sample 20 human reviews per run. automated checks must pass before CS notification.

deploy-bot: heads up 5 deployment blackout Fri 02:00-04:00 UTC. schedule around it.

maya (design): mock uploaded: /figma/link (private). includes the preview modal and one-line rationale UI.

carlos (cs): timeline note: customers want recommendations first, automated apply later. prioritize recommendation surface.

ana (product): negotiation: if timeline slips, cut options in this order: 1) pager/ops integration (keep email), 2) per-tenant default (ship per-route preview only), 3) confidence badge (ship text only). everyone ok?

tok (eng): agree with that cut order.

neel (ml): agree. paging is risky until metrics stable.

maya (design): i'll produce the minimal assets for eng by tomorrow.

carlos (cs): i'll start outreach and prepare FAQs.

ana (product): action items: tok + neel to list infra+ml tickets today; maya uploads final mini-mock; carlos to set pilot permissions; i'll assemble launch criteria doc. Friday 9am sync. thanks! :raised_hands:
